senses.gloss:
--a class of मनुष्य Pitr2s, as distinguished from Deva पितृस्; fed in monthly ceremonies; attain this status after duly performing the seven-fold karma;
1: Br. II. २८. ६९-78.
their path cannot be known even by तपस्, much less seen with mortal eyes; how they benefit by श्राद्ध in a wide sense; how those who get no श्राद्ध suffer.
2: वा. ५६. ६३-5, ६८-79.

senses.gloss: etc., one १०० Laukika years equal to 3 years of पितृस्; one year (लौकिकमानम्) equals one day for Devas.-- उत्तरायनम् is the day time and दक्षिणायनम् the night of gods, ३०३० years equal to one सप्तऋषि vatsara. Br. II. २९. 5-१७.

1: वा. २९. 7.
father of Brah- मोदनाग्नि, well-known as Bharata; also अथर्वा.
2: Br. II. १२. 7, 9.
